title: Version 1.37.0
body:
Version 1.37.0

August 18th, 2023

Added:

  • Revamped the entire map
  • Revamped all ore RNG
  • Added Mike's Mines
  • Added 4 new trees
  • Added 2 new rock types
  • Added Lad'r'
  • Added ??? M'i' -- (MOAI)
  • Added ??? M -- (METEOR)
  • Added ??? Q'st -- (QUEST)
  • Added ??? E'bane

Changed:

  • Schematics are now orange
  • Rebalanced various methods of making money
  • Updated various item, and box colors
  • Grabby Fly is no-longer possible
  • You can no-longer drag whilst sitting
  • Updated translational strings for items with old map terms
  • Updated translational string for CannedBeans and TrappedBeans

Version 1.37.1

August 18th, 2023

Changed:

  • Fixed some ores appearing as Empty
  • Fixed shiftlock being enabled

Version 1.37.2

August 18th, 2023

Changed:

  • Made rocks inside the mines smaller

Version 1.37.3

August 18th, 2023

Changed:

  • Meteors are now more likely to contain a meteor core
  • Buffed Sellner vehicle speed to better represent the map scale
  • Caves are no-longer as dark
  • Loads of rocks now spawn per region
  • Red Cactus now sells for slightly less
  • You can now actually reach Skull
  • Less dynamite is required for blowing up entrances
  • Emberbane effect now works on non-chopped magma trees as well

Version 1.37.4

August 18th, 2023

Added:

  • Added explosive site signs
  • Getting hit by a mushroom spore now launches you upwards
  • Added more rocks to make availability to olive tree region easier

Version 1.37.5

August 18th, 2023

Added:

  • Added rock pathway to purple cacti

Changed:

  • Made skull rock more accessible
  • Doubled the limit of trees in grasslands (spawn)
  • Grasslands entrance to the Acid area no-longer has low friction (YAY no rolling dynamite)

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed issue with mysterious mushroom boosts

Version 1.37.6

August 18th, 2023

Added:

  • Mysterious mushrooms now emit an anti-gravity region, allowing you to float!

Changed:

  • Made olive bark darker, as it was the same as king palm.. whoops..

Bug Fixes:

  • Alien trees no longer shoot spores if they are not fully grown to fix an issue

Version 1.37.7

August 18th, 2023

Added:

  • Added Planks between certain lava cracks to help with collecting Magma Wood
